brief.zh: 标出主干，把所有修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding every modifier away.

t.zh: 这一次，主语和宾语后面都跟着一串套一串的修饰成分。
t.en: This time both the subject and the object trail chains of modifiers, one inside another.

hint.zh: 句子里有两个 change。各自后面的修饰成分，分别挂在哪一个上？
hint.en: The sentence has two changes. Which one does each chain hang on?

sentence: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.

folds.span: in the weights of the first layer
in the output of the network

title.zh: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.
title.en: A small change in the weights of the first layer causes a large change in the output of the network.

body.zh: 主干只有五个词：A small change causes a large change。第一层权重的一点小变化，会让网络输出发生很大的变化。长句的长，几乎都长在修饰成分上。
body.en: The skeleton is five words: A small change causes a large change. A small change in the first layer’s weights makes a large change in the network’s output. A long sentence is long almost entirely in its modifiers.

note.zh: 先折修饰成分，再读主干。
note.en: Fold the modifiers first, then read the skeleton.
